verdict.rationale: Square provides a documented Webhooks system and a separate Disputes API, indicating webhook-driven event subscriptions including dispute-related events are supported, but the evidence pack never enumerates specific payment lifecycle event types (authorized, captured, refunded) or shows sample payloads/config for chaining automations. missing for 10: explicit list of payment event types (authorized/captured/refunded) in webhook docs, and a hands-on/independent example of using webhooks to drive downstream automation.
